title: Every template on every CMS is asked the same seven questions (name, logo, favicon, about, pages, language, tone), fitted to the template before hashing; brand pictures are checked, written in one undoable brand step; unticked pages are hidden by id
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/{build-questions,fit-questions,template-profiles,site-pages-schema,brief-brand-images,brief-brand,brief-picked-pages}.test.mjs
S3: Run: node --test --test-timeout=120000 packages/site/tracy-add-site/test/e2e/create-brief-sheet.test.mjs (a real browser over the wizard fixture)
S4: Read the exit code and the fail/skipped counts of each run.
expect: Every run exits 0 with 0 failures and 0 skipped tests.

resolveQuestions serves the CMS standard file whatever per-quickstart set, choice or /ops default exists; the logo question carries variants from the template profile (JA Vega WP ['dark'], JA Nova Joomla ['light','dark'], JA Prodex Joomla ['single']); the pages question carries the release's tracy_site_pages.json ids with home locked; languages is 'one'; logo and favicon are left out when the switch site-brand-uploads is off.
checkBrandImage refuses SVG/JPG/WebP/GIF even renamed .png (PNG_ONLY), a logo under 500 px, a favicon not square or under 512 px, a file over 8 MB; no favicon is ever generated.
setSiteBrand writes WordPress site_logo/site_icon with one apply id brand-<ts>, and apply.revert of that id removes them all; a refused write is skipped with a reason and the others still run.
unpickedById never returns the home page and hides exactly the unticked ids.

The sheet shows seven numbered cards, several open at once; logo tiles follow variants; SVG shows 'PNG only.'; Pages lists the template's pages with Home locked; the language select keeps exactly one.
evidence: 07/10/2026: seven default questions must work on WordPress, Joomla and EmDash for every gallery template (issue #1013, plan tasks/plan-ten-logo-favicon.md).
fence: Units over fake Apply doors and a fetch double, and the real wizard bundle in a browser. Not exercised here: Postgres-backed doors (run on CI), a running CMS, the dev surface.
